<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="r_Cw3-fCLBMnsqy347bh"> <mxGraphModel dx="1493" dy="814" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 A([Open Toleti-e]) --> B{Already signed in?}

 B -- No --> C[Enter email and password]
 C --> D{Credentials match?}
 D -- No --> E[Show sign-in error]
 E --> C
 D -- Yes --> F[Store signed-in flag in browser storage]

 B -- Yes --> G[Open dashboard]
 F --> G

 G --> H{Choose an action}

 H -- Open a document service --> I[Select document type]
 I --> J[Load records from the matching API collection]
 J --> K{Document action}
 K -- Create --> L[Complete document form]
 K -- Edit --> M[Update document details]
 K -- Delete --> N[Request document deletion]
 K -- Print --> O[Render print view and open browser print dialog]

 L --> P[Send POST request]
 M --> Q[Send PUT request with document ID]
 N --> R[Send DELETE request with document ID]

 P --> S[API validates document data]
 Q --> S
 R --> T[API updates the JSON collection file]
 S --> U{Data valid?}
 U -- No --> V[Return error to the application]
 U -- Yes --> T
 T --> W[Return result to the application]
 W --> X[Refresh displayed records]
 V --> K
 X --> K

 H -- Search documents --> Y[Request all six document collections]
 Y --> Z[Filter records in the browser]
 Z --> AA{Select a result?}
 AA -- Yes --> I
 AA -- No --> G

 H -- Sign out --> AB[Clear browser sign-in flag]
 AB --> AC([Return to sign-in screen])

 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
